text.i: Look, Mark, don’t go to Blackpool as you
usually do. Come to Brighton for your holidays
this year. It’s sunnier than Blackpool and over
the past few years the temperatures have been
better here than in the North, where Blackpool
is. Brighton’s pier has many more attractions
than Blackpool’s and the town’s fish and chip
shops are as good as Blackpool’s. Blackpool’s
beach may be sandier but Brighton’s also has
a lot more amusement arcades. There is also a
very fast and regular train service from London
to Brighton. The direct train takes only about
1 hour. That’s a lot less than the 4 hours it
takes to get to Blackpool. You must come to
Brighton this summer!

page.text: Since the dawn of history man has been

From that moment on a sort of media clash
was unleashed. All over the world people
debated about the question witch one
was the tallest; Sears or Petronas. Now the
answer to this question seems so easy. Just
measure both buildings from bottom to top,
and the tallest one gets the title. Question
